card.name: Linking words before body-part names
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (the, in, such, comma) just before a body part, nerve, or tissue is named, in surgical, anesthesia, or anatomy text.

modes.label: Article before anatomy
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'anterior' right before a tissue, muscle, or nerve area.
modes.example: Avoid Injection into<< the>> Platysma Prior to each treatment session

modes.label: Such as / in before body parts
modes.description: 'such' or 'in' leading into a list of body sites or functions.
modes.example: supplied by end arteries or having otherwise compromised blood supply<< such>> as digits, nose, external ear,

modes.label: Comma in exam lists
modes.description: A comma inside a list of limb checks, before the next sign such as color or sensation.
